notes.title: 《GuanLan Magic》 will be a part of SteamNextFest ！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44821688/f26721a630e5a21c298f32f7e8cbaa0c9edd0b5c.png[/img]

[GuanLan Magic] will soon participate in the Steam Next Fest in October.

For the hope of humanity, the decisive battle unfolds in the vast sky...
An STG featuring magical girls and an instant-upgrade system

You can try the demo version of the game.

The demo version includes the first stage of the game!

notes.title: Enhancement of the magic missile
notes.content:
[b]Enhancement of the magic missile[/b]

The magic missile's acceleration has increased, allowing it to reach a higher final speed!

Additionally, the magic missile can now clear enemy bullets it encounters in flight!

These features have been updated in the latest demo version, so players are encouraged to try it out!
